prompt_context: Draft an Interim Bail Application under the inherent powers of the Court read with BNSS Section 480/483. Interim bail is a short-duration release pending adjudication of the main regular bail / anticipatory bail application. The Hon'ble Supreme Court in Lal Kamlendra Pratap Singh v. State of U.P. (2009) 4 SCC 437 recognised the power of courts to grant interim bail. The application must establish: (1) pendency of a main bail application; (2) compelling urgency that cannot await the main hearing; (3) specific period sought; (4) undertakings of cooperation and surrender at end of interim period. Reference BNS section numbers for offences (never IPC). The application must be tight — interim bail is an exceptional remedy and the court must be satisfied of urgency.
promptInstructions: Draft an Interim Bail Application invoking inherent powers read with Section 480/483 BNSS, 2023.
Open with paragraph identifying applicant, FIR particulars and pending main bail application.
Establish the compelling urgency (medical emergency / death in family / examination / other) with dates and specifics.
State that the applicant has filed Bail Application No. ___ which is pending hearing on [date] — interim relief is sought for the intervening period.
Include undertakings: cooperation with investigation, will not tamper with evidence, will surrender on expiry of interim period.
Cite BNS sections (NEVER IPC) for the underlying offences.
Prayer must be SPECIFIC to interim duration — do not seek regular bail in this application.
Do NOT generate the verification clause or advocate signature block — those are added programmatically.
